arxiv-2101-10745.title: Interference Alignment Using Reaction in Molecular Interference Channels
arxiv-2101-10745.creator: Maryam Farahnak-Ghazani, Mahtab Mirmohseni, and Masoumeh Nasiri-Kenari
arxiv-2101-10745.description: Abstract Co-channel interference (CCI) is a performance limiting factor in molecular communication (MC) systems with shared medium. Interference alignment (IA) is a promising scheme to mitigate CCI in traditional communication systems. Due to the signal-dependent noise in MC systems, the traditional IA schemes are less useful in MC systems.

arxiv-2202-12493.title: Combined significance of spatial coincidence of high energy neutrinos from PSR B1509-58 by Super-Kamiokande and MACRO
arxiv-2202-12493.creator: Shantanu Desai
arxiv-2202-12493.description: Abstract In their searches for astrophysical point sources of high energy neutrinos, both the Super-Kamiokande and MACRO neutrino detectors saw the largest angular excess from the same source, viz. PSR B1509-58. We estimate the probability for the observed number of events by both Super-Kamiokande and MACRO to be a chance coincidence due to atmospheric neutrino background.

arxiv-2207-01320.title: City products of right-angled buildings and their universal groups
arxiv-2207-01320.creator: Jens Bossaert, Tom De Medts
arxiv-2207-01320.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jens Bossaert, Tom De Medts. We introduce the notion of city products of right-angled buildings that produces a new right-angled building out of smaller ones. More precisely, if M M is a right-angled Coxeter diagram of rank n n and Δ 1 , … , Δ n \Delta_{1},\dots,\Delta_{n} are right-angled buildings, then we construct a new right-angled building Δ := ⋈ M ⁡ ( Δ 1 , … , Δ n ) \Delta:=\operatorname{\rotatebox[x,y]{90.0}{$\bowtie$}}_{M}(\Delta_{1},\dots,\Delta_{n}) .

arxiv-2303-11287.title: Simultaneous Color Computer Generated Holography Conference: SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers; December 12–15, 2023; Sydney, NSW, Australia SIGGRAPH Asia 2023 Conference Papers (SA Conference Papers ’23), December 12–15, 2023, Sydney, NSW, Australia DOI: 10.1145/3610548.3618250 ISBN: 979-8-4007-
arxiv-2303-11287.creator: Eric Markley, Nathan Matsuda, Florian Schiffers, Oliver Cossairt, Grace Kuo
arxiv-2303-11287.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eric Markley, Nathan Matsuda, Florian Schiffers, Oliver Cossairt, Grace Kuo. Computer generated holography has long been touted as the future of augmented and virtual reality (AR/VR) displays, but has yet to be realized in practice. Previous high-quality, color holographic displays have made either a 3 × \times sacrifice on frame rate by using a sequential color illumination scheme or used more than one spatial light modulator (SLM) and/or bulky, complex optical setups.

arxiv-2408-14468.title: K-Sort Arena: Efficient and Reliable Benchmarking for Generative Models via K-wise Human Preferences
arxiv-2408-14468.creator: Zhikai Li, Xuewen Liu, Dongrong Joe Fu, Jianquan Li, Qingyi Gu, Kurt Keutzer, Zhen Dong
arxiv-2408-14468.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhikai Li, Xuewen Liu, Dongrong Joe Fu, Jianquan Li, Qingyi Gu, Kurt Keutzer, Zhen Dong. The rapid advancement of visual generative models necessitates efficient and reliable evaluation methods. Arena platform, which gathers user votes on model comparisons, can rank models with human preferences. However, traditional Arena methods, while established, require an excessive number of comparisons for ranking to converge and are vulnerable to preference noise in voting, suggesting the need for better approaches tailored to contemporary evaluation challenges.

arxiv-2409-03797.title: NESTful : A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Nested Sequences of API Calls
arxiv-2409-03797.creator: Kinjal Basu, Ibrahim Abdelaziz, Kiran Kate, Mayank Agarwal, Maxwell Crouse, Yara Rizk, Kelsey Bradford, Asim Munawar, Sadhana Kumaravel, Saurabh Goyal,, Xin Wang, Luis A. Lastras, and Pavan Kapanipathi
arxiv-2409-03797.description: Abstract The resurgence of autonomous agents built using large language models (LLMs) to solve complex real-world tasks has brought increased focus on LLMs’ fundamental ability of tool or function calling. At the core of these agents, an LLM must plan, execute, and respond using external tools, APIs, and custom functions.

arxiv-2410-13989.title: Reproducibility study of “LICO: Explainable Models with Language-Image Consistency"
arxiv-2410-13989.creator: Luan Fletcher luan.fletcher@student.uva.nlDepartment of Computer ScienceUniversity of Amsterdam, Robert van der Klis robert.van.der.klis@student.uva.nlDepartment of Computer ScienceUniversity of Amsterdam, Martin Sedláček martin.sedlacek@student.uva.nlDepartment of Computer ScienceUniversity of Amst
arxiv-2410-13989.description: Abstract The growing reproducibility crisis in machine learning has brought forward a need for careful examination of research findings. This paper investigates the claims made by Lei et al. (2023) regarding their proposed method, LICO, for enhancing post-hoc interpretability techniques and improving image classification performance.

arxiv-2501-00111.description: Abstract Given a binary string ω \omega over the alphabet { 0 , 1 } \{0,1\} , a vector ( a , b ) (a,b) is a Parikh vector if and only if a factor of ω \omega contains exactly a a occurrences of 0 0 and b b occurrences of 1 1 .

arxiv-2506-15019.title: Stable CDE Autoencoders with Acuity Regularization for Offline Reinforcement Learning in Sepsis Treatment
arxiv-2506-15019.creator: Yue Gao
arxiv-2506-15019.description: Abstract Effective reinforcement learning (RL) for sepsis treatment depends on learning stable, clinically meaningful state representations from irregular ICU time series. While previous works have explored representation learning for this task, the critical challenge of training instability in sequential representations and its detrimental impact on policy performance has been overlooked.

arxiv-2507-10347.title: Parallel Sampling of Diffusion Models on S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) SO(3)
arxiv-2507-10347.creator: Yan-Ting Chen, Hao-Wei Chen, Tsu-Ching Hsiao, and Chun-Yi Lee
arxiv-2507-10347.description: Abstract \finalcopy Abstract In this paper, we design an algorithm to accelerate the diffusion process on the SO(3) manifold. The inherently sequential nature of diffusion models necessitates substantial time for denoising perturbed data. To overcome this limitation, we proposed to adapt the numerical Picard iteration for the SO(3) space.

arxiv-2507-15021.title: Integrating Newton’s Laws with deep learning for enhanced physics-informed compound flood modeling
arxiv-2507-15021.creator: Soheil Radfar, Faezeh Maghsoodifar, Hamed Moftakhari, Hamid Moradkhani
arxiv-2507-15021.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Soheil Radfar, Faezeh Maghsoodifar, Hamed Moftakhari, Hamid Moradkhani. Coastal communities increasingly face compound floods, where multiple drivers like storm surge, high tide, heavy rainfall, and river discharge occur together or in sequence to produce impacts far greater than any single driver alone. Traditional hydrodynamic models can provide accurate physics-based simulations but require substantial computational resources for real-time applications or risk assessments, while machine learning alternatives often sacrifice physical consistency for speed, producing unrealistic predictions during extreme events.

arxiv-2507-21318.title: Black-Box Bug-Amplification for Multithreaded Software
arxiv-2507-21318.creator: Yeshayahu Weiss, Gal Amram, Achiya Elyasaf Eitan Farchi, Oded Margalit, Gera Weiss
arxiv-2507-21318.description: Abstract Bugs, especially those in concurrent systems, are often hard to reproduce because they manifest only under rare conditions. Testers frequently encounter failures that occur only under specific inputs, even when occurring with low probability. We propose an approach to systematically amplify the occurrence of such elusive bugs.

arxiv-2602-21958.title: Analysis of eigenvalue clustering leads to optimal scaling in numerical radiative transfer
arxiv-2602-21958.creator: Pietro Benedusi, Simone Riva, Luca Belluzzi, Stefano Serra-Capizzano
arxiv-2602-21958.description: Abstract We consider a multidimensional polychromatic radiative transfer (RT) problem, accounting for scattering processes in a general form, i.e. anisotropic (dipole) scattering with partial frequency redistribution. Given a discrete ordinates ( S N S_{N} ) discretization, we report the corresponding matrix structures, depending on model and discretization parameters.

pmc-10573187.creator: Elena Lucarini, Laura Micheli, Alessandra Toti, Clara Ciampi, Francesco Margiotta, Lorenzo Di Cesare Mannelli, Carla Ghelardini, Takuji Tanaka, Irmgard Tegeder
pmc-10573187.description: The management of abdominal pain in patients affected by inflammatory bowel diseases (IBDs) still represents a problem because of the lack of effective treatments. Acetyl L-carnitine (ALCAR) has proved useful in the treatment of different types of chronic pain with excellent tolerability.

pmc-11709736.title: Amylin vasculopathy impairs cerebral Aβ efflux through altering cerebral vasodilation
pmc-11709736.creator: Ravichandra S Davargaon, Noah S Leibold, Nirmal Verma, David K Powell, Florin Despa
pmc-11709736.description: BackgroundImpaired interstitial fluid drainage in the brain is indicated by the presence of perivascular β‐amyloid (Aβ) deposits and is attributed to alterations in contractility and relaxation of vascular smooth muscle cells (SMCs). The brain microvasculature in Alzheimer disease (AD) accumulates amyloid‐forming amylin secreted from the pancreas.

pmc-11798954.title: Esports physical exercise/performance matrix 1.0 country factsheets: results and analyses from Serbia
pmc-11798954.creator: Xuanyu Zhou, Yuwen Hu, Radenko M. Matic, Stevo Popovic
pmc-11798954.description: The Serbian Country Factsheets on Physical Exercise and Performance for Esports Players provide a foundational assessment of nine physical exercise and performance indicators tailored to esports athletes. This study utilizes Serbia’s Esports Physical Exercise/Performance Matrix 1.0 framework, integrating recent peer-reviewed studies and nationally representative secondary data to evaluate these indicators.

pmc-13206417.title: Coix Seed Oil Ameliorates Rheumatoid Arthritis by Modulating Inflammation-Associated Metabolic Pathways
pmc-13206417.creator: Yong Yang, Ying Feng, Weijie Tang, Yu Meng, Xiuping Ma
pmc-13206417.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic disease that primarily manifests as symmetrical joint inflammation. Although Coix Seed Oil (CSO) has demonstrated anti-inflammatory effects in RA rat models, its systemic metabolic regulatory mechanisms remain unclear. Therefore, we aimed to investigate whether CSO ameliorates RA by modulating inflammation-associated metabolic pathways.
